checkpoints.description: [1/1] Verification: failing-first smoke, 156 unittests, headless Edge marker color check
[1/1] Deep-link URL options and keyboard shortcuts for both studios

impact_assessment.why: the sealed build could not reproduce the served studio's option overrides (applyWebOptions) or the tooltips' promised Space/R keys, so deep links and scripted demos were impossible
impact_assessment.benefits: index.html?world=X&rate=..&reverse=1&c=..&ke=..&collision=.. reproduces any served-studio configuration and Space/R work in both UIs
impact_assessment.risks: contract: keyboard must ignore form-control focus and e.repeat; dependency: no new deps; concurrency: none; state: README documents the parameters
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests: HTML_PAGE assertions and stub-recorded keydown dispatch; full unittest + smoke suites; headless Edge check of every parameter

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Announce studio boot on the first painted frame (body data-screen)

impact_assessment.why: the AegeanWorks live watchdog can only guess whether the embedded studio actually started; a first-frame handshake gives it a definitive signal
impact_assessment.benefits: the live page can distinguish real starts from broken scripts once it opts into the handshake
impact_assessment.risks: contract: byte-parity between web.py and sealed src/orrery.js; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Re-fit the canvas backings when the HUD panel collapses

impact_assessment.why: collapsing the HUD changes the canvas layout box without a window resize, so the canvas stayed mis-sized until the next window resize
impact_assessment.benefits: the canvas fills the freed layout immediately, in both direction of the HUD toggle
impact_assessment.risks: contract: parity between web.py and sealed src/orrery.js; dependency: ResizeObserver guard plus HUD-click fallback; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first smoke stub, HTML_PAGE test, 157-suite, ruff, headless two-way refit check

checkpoints.checklists: passed: unittest(158), studio smoke, ruff, headless two-way refit

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Archive orrery: move to projects/archive, flip GitHub repo read-only, flag live catalog archived:true

impact_assessment.why: User requested retirement; all open work complete

impact_assessment.mitigation: Ledger completed pre-move; catalog flag verified against sync --check; no further orrery builds planned

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Make the write-back visible from the AegeanWorks wrapper: postMessage the synced query to the parent window when embedded, and drop non-builtin world keys so custom uploads cannot produce dead deep links

impact_assessment.why: Verified live: the wrapper address bar never reflects in-frame state, so copied links lose it; custom upload keys silently fall back to solar on reload
impact_assessment.benefits: Site users can share the exact live configuration from the address bar; no dead keys in URLs
impact_assessment.risks: contract: frame gains a same-origin liveState message; wrapper listener validates event.origin and event.source identity; dependency: allowlist shared with the site's forwarding keys; concurrency: repo re-archived so push needs a temporary unarchive; state: new build digest and shot pin
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first smoke (parent capture, merged wrapper search in mjs); full battery; unarchive-rearchive cycle again; deployed playwright check of the mirrored address bar
